backend/main.mo: Main actor implementing a media sharing platform with video/photo upload, user profiles, channels, comments, likes, and role-based access control using mixins for storage and authorization.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that defines old and new actor state types and provides a run function to transform state during canister upgrades, currently performing identity transformations.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting frontend-backend integration validation with high confidence, listing 10 frontend files that reference the deployed backend canister.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of 23 frontend files describing React components, pages, hooks, and configuration for the media sharing platform UI.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining a complete design system using OKLCH colors for both light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the MediaShare application with root div and module script reference to main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component configuring TanStack Router with 10 routes including home, galleries, upload pages, player/viewer pages, settings, channel profiles, and upgrade.
frontend/src/components/AddToPlaylistMod: Empty component file with no implementation.
frontend/src/components/AuthButton.tsx: Authentication button component integrating Internet Identity with dropdown menu showing truncated principal and sign out option when authenticated.
frontend/src/components/ChannelNameDispl: Reusable component that fetches and displays a channel name as a clickable link to the channel profile, showing truncated principal as fallback with loading skeleton.
frontend/src/components/CommentSection.t: React component that displays a comment section for videos with form to add comments (authenticated users only), loading states, and list of existing comments with author avatars and timestamps.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout component with sticky header containing navigation links (Home, Videos, Photos), upload dropdown menu, upgrade button, settings menu, authentication button, and footer with social media links.
frontend/src/components/PhotoCard.tsx: Card component displaying photo metadata including thumbnail, title, uploader channel name, and upload date with click navigation to photo detail page.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal dialog that prompts authenticated users without profiles to enter their name (required) and optional channel name (3-30 characters) on first login.
frontend/src/components/UpgradePrompt.ts: Card component that displays premium upgrade benefits (unlimited uploads, 4K quality, priority support) to free tier users with navigation to upgrade page.
frontend/src/components/VideoCard.tsx: Card component displaying video metadata including thumbnail, title, uploader channel name, upload date, like count, and comment count with click navigation to video detail page.
frontend/src/components/VideoQualitySele: Dropdown menu component for selecting video quality (auto, 360p, 480p, 720p, 1080p) with visual indicator of current selection.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance with authentication, initializes access control with admin token, and invalidates dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAddComment.ts: Mutation hook for adding comments to videos that invalidates related queries on success and shows toast notifications for success/error states.
frontend/src/hooks/useChannelName.ts: Query hook that fetches and caches channel name for a given principal, falling back to principal string if unavailable.
frontend/src/hooks/useComments.ts: Query hook that fetches comments for a specific video ID using the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetCallerUserProfi: Query hook that fetches the current authenticated user's profile with custom loading state that accounts for actor initialization.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetUserSubscriptio: React Query hook that fetches user subscription status (free/premium tier and features). Currently returns a hardcoded free tier as a placeholder until backend implementation is complete.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication, providing login/logout functionality, identity management, and authentication status tracking with configurable AuthClient options.
frontend/src/hooks/usePhoto.ts: React Query hook that fetches a single photo by ID from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/usePhotos.ts: React Query hook that fetches a list of all photo metadata from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/usePhotoUpload.ts: React Query mutation hook for uploading photos with progress tracking, converting files to Uint8Array and invalidating photo queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useSaveCallerUserProf: React Query mutation hook for saving user profile data, invalidating profile and channel name queries on success with toast notifications.
frontend/src/hooks/useSearchVideos.ts: React Query hook that searches videos by term and fetches full video data for each result, enabled only when search term is non-empty.
frontend/src/hooks/useSetChannelName.ts: React Query mutation hook for setting channel name with validation (3-30 characters), invalidating related queries and showing toast notifications.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpgradeAccount.ts: React Query mutation hook for upgrading user accounts to premium tier. Currently throws an error as backend implementation is not yet complete.
frontend/src/hooks/useUserStats.ts: React Query hook that fetches user statistics for a given principal with 5-minute cache duration.
frontend/src/hooks/useVideo.ts: React Query hook that fetches a single video by ID from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useVideoLike.ts: React Query mutation hook for liking videos, invalidating video queries on success and handling authentication and duplicate like errors.
frontend/src/hooks/useVideos.ts: React Query hook that fetches a list of all video metadata from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useVideoUpload.ts: React Query mutation hook for uploading videos with progress tracking, converting files to Uint8Array and invalidating video queries on success.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark themes, defining colors for UI components, charts, and sidebar elements using OKLCH color space.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query and Internet Identity providers, then renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/ChannelProfile.tsx: Channel profile page component that displays user information, stats, and tabbed content for videos and photos filtered by the channel owner's principal.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Landing page component with hero banner, call-to-action buttons for browsing videos/photos, and upload cards linking to video and photo upload pages.
frontend/src/pages/PhotoGallery.tsx: Photo gallery page that displays a grid of photo cards with search/filter functionality and loading/error states using the usePhotos hook.
frontend/src/pages/PhotoViewer.tsx: Individual photo viewer page that displays a single photo with metadata (title, uploader, description) by converting Uint8Array to blob URL for rendering.
frontend/src/pages/Settings.tsx: User settings page for managing profile (name, channel name) and displaying subscription status with forms to save profile data and channel name.
frontend/src/pages/Upgrade.tsx: Subscription upgrade page that displays free vs premium tier comparison cards and allows authenticated users to upgrade their account to premium.
frontend/src/pages/UploadPhoto.tsx: Photo upload form page with file picker, title/description inputs, preview functionality, and progress tracking using the usePhotoUpload hook.
frontend/src/pages/UploadVideo.tsx: React component for video upload page with form inputs for title, description, and file selection; includes authentication check, upload progress display, and success/error states.
frontend/src/pages/VideoGallery.tsx: React component displaying a grid of video cards with search functionality using debounced input; fetches all videos or filtered search results and shows loading/error states.
frontend/src/pages/VideoPlayer.tsx: React component for playing individual videos with metadata display, comment section, and share functionality; converts Uint8Array video data to blob URL for playback.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting and managing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support for maintaining state across navigation.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom color scheme using OKLCH color space, extended theme settings for container, typography, animations, and design system tokens for UI components.
project_state.json: Project metadata tracking deployment issues, feature requests for diagnosing deployment failures, backend migration verification, and actor method type signature validation.
